//	PeakTimeSet 0 / PeakTimeEnd 2400 means the whole day, so the day flag alone drives it. RewardExpRate 0.1
//	is added into the kill-exp multiplier (benefit = 1.0 + rate), i.e. +10%. EndTime is deliberately 0, not 2400:
//	IEventControlPeakTime::_SendEventNotify only broadcasts ePEAKTIME_END when the end hh:mm has been reached,
//	and the event deactivates at Monday 00:00, so an EndTime of 2400 would leave the client banner stuck on.
